summary: The milestone completed 11 experiments in 45.6 minutes, including 3 compute-bound experiments. The 32.17-minute Live ARC adapter-withheld transition-witness comparison was the dominant compute-bound entry; the locked field records no compute-task GPU-idle condition, while the uncorrelated snapshot cannot establish overall compute-window efficiency.
bottlenecks_identified: Live ARC adapter-withheld transition-witness comparison was the longest compute-bound experiment at 32.17 minutes, followed by Held-out source fidelity on the mandated Qwen3.8 GGUF at 5.77 minutes and Bounded Qwen3.8 mention extraction with authenticated floors at 1.28 minutes; the timing block provides no phase-level cause for those durations.
Disk-mtime reconstruction gives experiment-level elapsed time but no stage spans, so setup, model loading, inference, validation, and artifact work cannot be separated.
Accelerator samples are not attached to experiment start and stop boundaries, so compute-window device efficiency cannot be evaluated from the available snapshot.
No model-count or runner-selection receipt is available, so the evidence does not establish that a task with 2 or more models in parallel failed to engage DualGPURunner.
improvements_suggested: Emit task-scoped phase timers for preparation, model loading, inference, validation, and artifact writing, especially for the longest compute-bound comparison.
Sample GPU utilization only inside each declared compute window and attach the samples to that experiment's receipt.
Record model_count, requested parallelism, selected runner, and GPU assignment at launch; select DualGPURunner only when 2 or more models are loaded in parallel.
Add restartable phase checkpoints to the longest comparison so interrupted work can resume from a completed boundary.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Instrument the 32.17-minute compute-bound comparison with phase timers and restartable checkpoints.
Bind GPU telemetry to explicit compute-window start and stop events in every compute-bound experiment.
Persist model-count and runner-choice receipts, with DualGPURunner eligibility limited to parallel runs loading 2 or more models.
meta_reflection: The duration ranking is clear, but the available reconstruction and idle snapshot do not reveal which internal stage created the critical path. Estimated savings remain at 0 percent because the supplied blocks contain no measured optimization counterfactual.
